svg.title: Where SILKern sits in a context-parallel decode step
svg.desc: A sparse selector picks global positions for one query, t = [8, 5, 130, 7, -1, 262], and every rank of a two-rank decode receives the same row. Each rank runs SILKern with its own rank number and the page table P: rank 0 keeps tokens 8, 130 and 262 and returns physical slots [708, 129, 451, -1, -1, -1] with count 3; rank 1 keeps tokens 5 and 7 and returns [706, 707, -1, -1, -1, -1] with count 2. Each rank's sparse attention gathers those slots from its own paged KV cache, drawn as physical blocks 2, 7 and 11, and produces partial softmax terms (m, N, Z); one step across both ranks combines them into y = N / Z. SILKern's stages are highlighted.
svg.text: the same row on every rank
combine across ranks: m = maxr mr, N = ∑r exp(mr − m) Nr, Z = ∑r exp(mr − m) Zr, y = N/Z
